title: AJTC Trigger-Chain Plugin Manifest
description: Machine-validatable manifest for an AJTC trigger chain treated as a plugin unit. Superset of the existing chain frontmatter; new fields (trigger/dependencies/provides/pluginForm/contract) are opt-in and auto-inferred when absent (see docs/trigger-chain-plugin-standard.md §3, §9).

name.description: Unique plugin id, equals the chain's `id`.

tier.description: Priority layer (see spec §6.1). Must not be null/absent.

pluginForm.description: Plugin shape (see spec §8.1). Inferred from tier/name when absent.

on.description: Entry activation signal. `chain.start` = invoked directly; `signal.x.y` = activated by upstream signal.

when.description: Optional bare-expression guard. NOTE: must NOT use {{ }} render wrapping (engine evaluates as expression).

entryNode.description: Id of the plugin's entry node.

dependencies.description: inject: ids of plugins this plugin requires ACTIVE before it may load.

provides.description: Capabilities this plugin exposes for others to consume by name.

contract.description: Outbound output contract summary (aggregated from the deliver node's `expect`).

_source.description: Provenance metadata added by the generator (not part of the runtime contract).
